description_en: Changes the root account password of a host
description_zh: 调用ModifyDedicatedHostPassword接口修改主机root密码
kebab_example: aliyun cddc modify-dedicated-host-password --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --new-password test00000 --dedicated-host-id ch-bp10a5id3boqi0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDedicatedHostPassword

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the host. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/213010.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The new password.

The password must be 8 to 32 characters in length.
The password must contain at least three of the following character types: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters.
The password can contain the following special characters: `! @ # $ % ^ & * ( ) _ + - =`

If your dedicated cluster runs SQL Server, the password cannot contain the account name (case-insensitive)
parameters.help_zh:
新密码。密码要求：

长度为8~32位。

须同时包含大写、小写、数字、特殊字符中的3种。

特殊字符为：`!@#$%^&*()_+-=`

当您的引擎为SQL Server时，密码要求不能包含账户名（忽略大小写）
parameters.name: new_password

parameters.help_en: The host ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/200944.html operation to query the host ID
parameters.name: dedicated_host_id
